query: What do Samsung Galaxy S7 reviews say about screen clarity, brightness, and touchscreen reliability?
search_text: What do reviews say about screen clarity, brightness, and touchscreen reliability?

rows.text: Also, what's the point of putting a beautiful screen on a phone if you have to keep it at 10% screen brightness the whole time? I'll be switching to a Droid Turbo because I actually want to use my phone.
Reliable phone. Screen quality is fantastic even when taking photos. The battery life is pretty good, too. Reliable phone.

Should of known better. Bought it as refurbished. Seemed good for the first couple days other than the screen being extra sensitive... then after the first week the screen got light lines across it like the brightness is messed up but when adjusted it doesn't change anything... bottom line save the time and hassle... just by new
Galaxy s7. I appreciate that I did get a deal, but it did not say that there were screen burns in the description or else I would have never bought it. I feel its kind of a waste of 80 bucks.

I use it frequently at home. Often when I press the Home button it registers a touch at the very bottom of the screen first, which is annoying, like as I'm exiting Gmail it opens up the last email momentarily and marks it as Read. Brightness of screen can't be adjusted low enough for use in the dark, so I use Lux Dash app, but that's kind of a hack and interferes with some apps.

I ordered this phone "refurbished " from edge cellular it .... I ordered this phone "refurbished " from edge cellular it has chips and dings on the screen and a hole on the back. Went back to my cart looked at the description it says light signs of use. I don't think a hole falls under light.

The screen is extra sensitive, even after calibration. I scroll, and am very careful not to move my finger too fast or double tap, but the phone 30-40% of the time registers it as a tap. Also, wifi cuts in and out. I have switched routers, reset phone, ect, but the wifi drops a few times an hour. Mostly when the phone screen turns off. The screen picture is beautiful. can't say much more than that. Can't wait to try with the Gear VR. Finally, call quality. For me, the speaker is not very loud, both on speaker phone mode and off. Sound on the other end of the call seems adequate, so no complaints there. In summary, the phone is pretty dang good. The now useless edge screen, wifi issues, screen sensitivity issues, and app issues are the reasons why the phone does not get a perfect score.
Great phone. A great phone at a very attractive price. Excellent clarity on both screen and audio.

I just wish it worked more reliably. Too often it says I need to hold my thumb on it longer, or to wipe the screen. I've set up all 4 fingerprint IDs, each having about 10 different print pictures, with my thumb from different holding angles, but it still has trouble from time to time. - I love Wireless and Fast Charging. And I love the animation on the screen showing you where your charge is coming from. When wireless charging, a cool white exploding ring comes from the middle of the screen (and then is gone). When charging from the usb port, that white exploding ring comes from the bottom of the screen (near the usb port). I've had no problem with Fast Charging either. USB and Wireless both do great (even with the holster cover I use). - Battery life seems good so far.

Why are the reviews for a different phone?. Why are there reviews for the "ZTE Majesty Pro" on the page that's supposed to be for Samsung Galaxy S7? I want to know what peopls think of the phone I'm thinking of buying. So, it says 28 reviews of the s7, but when you go to the reviews, you get 3 or 4, then it switches to the ZTE phone. Three or 4 reviews is not enough to make an informed decision. I'm on tracfone because it's inexpensive and works the way I need it. I don't want to waste time setting it up, find out it doesn't work, and have to re-do my old phone. Not to mention misleading with the number of reviews. Anyone out there ... how's it working for YOU?

Samsung Galaxy S7 Nice Phone. Item as described. Item was listed as "Acceptable" so I was hasten to buy a used phone because of some negative reviews. I checked and reviewed a lot of Samsung Galaxy S7 from other Sellers and asked for pictures. No one really responded. Wireless-Globe already had pictures posted so that was great. There was only 3 minor scratches on the screen which did not effect the screen. It came with the original Samsung charger. I was surprised that the phone came with a screen protector as already on the phone and a case. Thanks! I had to return the screen protector and case I got from Amazon. Battery life was not as long lasting as my Samsung Galaxy S7 Edge (which I dropped and broke the screen). As long as you don't watch YouTube videos in high definition or playing a lot of games, the battery should be fine.

The take-away: My S7 : I'm not sure how it's going to turn out. It may end up being great, but I'm a little concerned about the flickering screen & battery life. The other S7: So far so good, I have more faith in this phone than the one I use. Will I be surprised if the both die within the next year? Not really. And we got a great deal on them if they last. So I'm going to stay middle of the road on my review. They may end up being great phones, but signs of possible future problems make me wary.

I would still recommend this phone over any other phone. In this review, I will be comparing the Galaxy S7 Edge to the Galaxy S6 Edge. When the Galaxy S6 came out last year, it was one of the most unique phones on the market. The dual curved display was something to behold, even though it was mainly good for the “waterfall” scrolling effect and coolness factor. It had and still has excellent hardware inside and the 5.1” screen fits in almost every type of hand. A year later we have the Galaxy S7 Edge, which comes with a bigger screen, bigger battery and better hardware.

Not the same as a real retail purchased phone.... My wife has the same phone but she bought retail at a big box brick and mortar store. Her screen is much better than the phone I got off here. Better clarity, much more vibrant colors... and my battery life is pitiful in comparison. It has not even been 8 months and I am wanting to take it somewhere for a new battery, while hers is doing just fine. Last time I try to save money buying a phone outside a real retailer. I feel cheated with this one.

Wireless charging and quick charge 2.0 is incredibly nice to have -- being able to charge this phone from 3% to 100% in under an hour. After owning and using this phone for the past 7 months, I can tell you that it's a great phone. The 5.1 inch beautiful bright display, even in sunlight, this phone is a one hand operating gem at Quad HD Super AMOLED 2560×1440 577dpi. That's dense clarity at high resolution. It has 4GB of memory powered with the latest Quad-Core 820 snapdragon allows me to shift between apps and browsing with ease. It feels fluid. The camera for stills and video is superb, good shutter speed, great fast focus, and super resolution capabilities -- you can capture moments without any delay. The S7 also has improved low light camera to capture better pictures during night time.

Received a defective item.. Hi, the screen is not properly responding to touch. It is very difficult to perform press-hold on this screen. Several areas of the screen is significantly less responsive to touch as well. I am deeply frustrated as this is second time I am receiving a defective phone - I just returned my previous purchase due to some other screen problem.

Nice but Not Reliable. When the phone works, it does quite well. The camera is very good and the ability to connect calls is average. The battery life is average, too, as I am not a big user of the phone yet it runs down daily. Worse if I leave some screen features on. The camera takes very good photos. After the first year, the charging port failed so I had no way to charge the phone using a cable. Fortunately a wireless charger worked. During the second year, the screen began to go black with no image. I learned through Youtube that you can depress two buttons and get it to re-start. This is happening more and more frequently and is very annoying. My Galaxy S6 got just a little liquid near it and was destroyed. I am finished buying Samsung products, as the quality is suspect.
Would recommend!. So far so good! Fast, beautiful screen. Haven't tested the camera yet however the low light detection is phenomenal

They say there are not many people who even break theirs so they order the screen on and as needed basis. Overall I like the phone ! Like the apps Microsoft excel and Microsoft word. Battery last me most the day unless I stay on it more than 6 hours .I'm a contractor ... got to keep the deliveries and information flowing. It's very difficult to not have it.

Like brand new!. It says "refurbished", but the one I got seems brand new to me. Not a single blemish on it. Works like new; and the transfer from my old Samsung was super easy using a transfer cable. I love the 'Active' series and thus far have been impressed with their durability and reliability. I have dropped an S7 active before and the screen did crack, but they are not indestructible. I love it.
